{"diagnosis":"The new 'v2' collector writes txn_ts about 6 hours ahead of the legacy collector, probably UTC versus local CST. v2 rows start at 12:00 where legacy rows start at 06:00, and max txn_ts (2026-01-19 04:49) is later than the batch ingest time (02:00). Late-evening v2 transactions therefore roll into the next date, which explains the 00:00-06:00 spikes and the thin 2026-01-19 volume. The fix subtracts 6 hours from v2 timestamps in silver_transactions.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.68,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH t AS (
  SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
         customer_id,
         CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
         CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
         CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
)
SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM t;"}}
